history.summary: Fixed all four iteration-4 review findings in internal/docsguard, docs/test-only: (1) Authorization header name stays case-insensitive but the Bearer scheme itself now requires the runtime's exact case-sensitive 'Bearer' casing (strings.TrimPrefix in middleware.extractExplicitAPICredential is case-sensitive) -- any other casing (bearer/BEARER/BeaRer) is flagged as raw_authorization, while unrelated schemes (Basic/Digest/Negotiate/NTLM) remain case-insensitively allowed per RFC 7235; (2) hasParameterCredential now finds every key= token via regexp, percent-decodes the key with net/url.QueryUnescape, and compares the decoded value to exactly 'api_key', catching percent-encoded names like api%5Fkey that Go's net/url and net/http would also decode and accept at runtime; (3) ScanText's signature changed to ([]Violation, error), propagating bufio.Scanner's Err() (including ErrTooLong on an oversized line) instead of silently returning fewer violations, and cmd/docsguard fails closed (exit 2) on any scan error; (4) docs/API_KEY_TRANSPORT_DEPRECATION.md's Content-Type wording corrected to describe the parsed media type (via Go's mime.ParseMediaType, which ParseForm calls) rather than an exact string match, explicitly noting media-type parameters such as charset=UTF-8 are allowed and ignored -- verified empirically with a throwaway Go program. Added fixture tests for every new/changed rule: wrong-case Bearer (positive) alongside exact-case and header-name-case-insensitive (negative); percent-encoded api_key query/form parameters (positive) alongside a percent-encoded non-matching key (negative); an oversized-line-then-forbidden-suffix test at both the internal/docsguard and cmd/docsguard levels proving fail-closed behaviour. No runtime auth/middleware/header/status/version/dependency change. VERSION unchanged (0.12.1).
